title: TOKENATXOR
tagline: A dapp combining DEFI and ART by creating your own NFT via a video, photo or VFR.
description: This project includes a clone from Aavegotchi platform to enable you to have you own nft design and possibly to interact with current Aavegotchis. Becasue this was to be a multi dapp, you would be able to create entirely new NFT's like videos NFT and interact with the Livepeer platform. In addition you could chose integration with Ether Cards.
how_its_made: The project uses solidity, typescript, ethers and react with bootstrap to enable an easy to use dapp on the web. It is based mainly off of the Diamond standard that allows you to have a larger contract and of course upgradeable. The front end will provide a easy to use, secure platform that is pleasing to the eyes and fun to use.
